fields.description: Program Description The Training Objectives This program is based on core skills of Accreditation Board for Artificial Intelligence that meets the requirements of Shanghai University of Engineering Science instructional guidelines. The curriculum provides a broad education in the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence. The SUES core is made up of a general education courses and spescific Artificial Intelligence requirements of the accreditation guidelines such as Machine Learning, Group Intelligence, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing, Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality. The educational objectives are to provide each graduate with: 1) Engineering Competence that graduates are competent and engaged professionals in their field; 2) Continuous Learning Skills that graduates continue developing professionally; 3) Professional Skills that graduates demonstrate teamwork and leadership skills, and are contributors in their profession; 4) Societal Awareness that graduates recognize the societal, ethical, and global impacts of their work. Main Courses Machine Learning, Group Intelligence, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, Natural Language Processing, Virtual Reality & Augmented Reality, etc.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Digital ID photo * 2. Photocopy of passport If the passport has been extended, a passport extension page should be included. If you are not in your home country during the application, your current valid visa in that country is also required. * 3. Proof of English proficiency An applicant who is an English native speaker, or receives a high school diploma from an English-speaking country, may be exempt from this requirement. The applicant must pass the online entrance examination organized by CIE. The language examination can be waived if an IELTS band score no less than 5.5, or TOEFL(ibt) score no less than 60, is submitted. * 4. Senior high school diploma or high school equivalency diploma Translation for high school certificate and transcript need to be notarized, or bearing the official seal from school. If you apply before the completion of high school, an official letter issued by the institute indicating the time when you will receive the diploma is required. Copy of diploma and final version of the transcripts are still required once you receive them. * 5. Senior high school or high school equivalency full transcripts Translation for high school certificate and transcript need to be notarized, or bearing the official seal from school. If you apply before the completion of high school, an official letter issued by the institute indicating the time when you will receive the diploma is required. Copy of diploma and final version of the transcripts are still required once you receive them. * 6. Proof or Commitment of Financial Support You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Study plan * 8. Physical Examination Form -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s suggestion, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo or contain abnormal examination results will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 10. Application Commitment Letter You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. Non-criminal Record Certificate or Affirmation You can download a template or sample from here . * 12. Birth certificate Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizen complying with relevant regulations such as the "Notice of Ministry of Education on Regulating the Work Related to the Admission of International Students by Higher Education Institutions in China" 2. Aged from 18-25 (those who are between 16 and 18 should submit Guardian's Guarantee Statement) 3. Senior high school diploma (or above) 4. In good health 5. For English-taught undergraduate programs: meeting one of the following requirements: native English speaker, or with IELTS band score no less than 5.5, or with TOEFL(ibt) score no less than 60, or passing English test by SUES.
